inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description:
Whether or not an accordion item is disabled from user interaction.
When `true`, prevents the user from interacting with the item.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description:
A unique value for this item. Values use reference/value identity.
Omitted or nullish values receive a stable generated identity.

outputs.name: onOpenChange
outputs.description:
Cancelable request emitted before Root onValueChange and before commit.
External value changes and sibling closure do not emit a request.

parts.description:
Owns the entire Panel host and Angular children. Apply `*rdxAccordionPanelPresence` to the
`rdxAccordionPanel` host. To retain its view, use `{ keepMounted: true }` or set Root keepMounted.
The template and native host share the Item's existing render lifecycle.

inputs.name: rdxAccordionPanelPresence
inputs.description: Optional per-panel mount/search overrides, including explicit false.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Optional explicit panel id. When set, the trigger's `aria-controls` points to this id.

inputs.name: defaultValue
inputs.description:
The default active value of the item(s).

Use when you do not need to control the state of the item(s).

inputs.name: hiddenUntilFound
inputs.description:
Allow collapsed panels to remain mounted (but hidden) so the browser's in-page search
can find and reveal them. Mirrors Base UI's `hiddenUntilFound`.

inputs.name: keepMounted
inputs.description:
Whether to keep the content of collapsed items mounted in the DOM.
When `true`, closed panels keep their element in the DOM while hidden.

inputs.name: loopFocus
inputs.description:
Deprecated following the APG guidance update to remove roving focus.
This prop no longer affects keyboard focus behavior.

inputs.name: multiple
inputs.description:
Allow multiple panels to be open simultaneously. In single mode an open item can always be
closed by clicking its trigger again (Base UI parity — there is no separate `collapsible`).

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.description:
The orientation of the accordion.

Deprecated following the APG guidance update to remove roving focus.
This prop no longer affects keyboard focus behavior.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description:
The controlled expanded values, in both single and multiple modes.
A defined array owns selection until the parent updates it. Use `[(value)]` for two-way binding.

outputs.name: onValueChange
outputs.description:
Event handler called when the expanded value changes. Emits the next value plus a cancelable
`eventDetails` (Base UI parity); call `eventDetails.cancel()` to reject the change.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Authored native ID, registered reactively for the Panel's accessible label.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: The `type` attribute applied to native `<button>` hosts.

inputs.name: tabIndex
inputs.description:
The authored tab order, overriding disabled and composite defaults.
`null` removes the attribute; `undefined` restores the default.

inputs.name: role
inputs.description: The authored ARIA role. `null` removes the attribute; `undefined` restores the default.
